title: Sell AI-designed printable planners on Etsy
summary: Use Gemini and Canva to ship one niche planner, list it, and collect your first five dollars without holding inventory.
heroMetric: First listing in one focused afternoon
overview: You are not building a planner empire on day one. You pick a narrow buyer (exam season, Ramadan fasting log, freelance invoice week), generate a structured interior with Gemini, lay it out in Canva, export PDF, and list with honest photos. Income is not guaranteed; the loop is listing quality plus a handful of genuine reviews.

for: People who can spend 3–6 hours at a laptop
Sellers who will write a specific listing, not 'best planner ever'
notFor: Anyone expecting sales with zero marketing
People unwilling to check copyright on icons

blueprint.title: Pick a buyer who already searches
blueprint.body: Write one sentence: who, when, and what they need dated. Example: 'Final-year students who need a 8-week revision timetable they can print at home.' Reject generic 'productivity'.

blueprint.title: Draft the interior structure
blueprint.body: List 8–12 page types (cover, how to use, weekly, habit, notes). Keep page count under 30 for v1 so you actually finish.

blueprint.title: Generate copy and layout prompts
blueprint.body: Run the gated prompts. Paste Gemini output into Canva. Use free fonts only. Export print-ready PDF (A4 and US Letter).

blueprint.title: List and ask for one proof
blueprint.body: Upload to Etsy or a Gumroad link. Price modestly. Share with three real people and save the listing URL as your EarnLoop proof.

prompts.title: Niche validator
prompts.prompt: I want to sell a printable planner. Buyer: {{buyer}}. Season or constraint: {{constraint}}. List 10 specific Etsy-style titles that a real person might search. Flag any that sound like trademarked exam boards. Then pick the strongest 3 and explain why in one sentence each.

prompts.title: Interior page spec
prompts.prompt: Create a page-by-page spec for a {{pageCount}}-page printable for {{buyer}}. For each page: purpose, sections, empty fields the user fills, and a Canva layout hint (columns, checkboxes). No medical or financial advice. Tone: calm, practical.

monetization.model: Digital product, one SKU, then variations
steps: Add a dated version each quarter
Bundle three related printables after 10 sales
monetization.affiliateNotes: If you recommend Canva Pro, disclose the affiliate link.

seo.title: Sell printable planners with Gemini and Canva
seo.description: A realistic EarnLoop blueprint: niche, layout, list, and log proof of your first digital product.
